project.name: XPath catalog queries
project.description: Parse, inspect and format typed XPath source; filter namespaced product data, join suppliers, inspect retained nodes and native map/array results, and repair saved query source.

entries.name: Validate the expanded-name XPath source
entries.description: Validate standalone XPath grammar, explicit namespace names and supported source policy without running a document query.

entries.name: Parse the typed XPath source
entries.description: Present the native XPath expression and original token ranges as CEM-ML without interpreting EQNames as CEM structure.

entries.name: Parse the original XPath token events
entries.description: Present lossless native XPath token events, including the original comment and source byte positions, without evaluating the query.

entries.name: Inspect the native XPath source
entries.description: Inspect the typed XPath source owner, EQNames and original UTF-8 ranges through the shared CEM-ML presentation.

entries.name: Format the XPath source
entries.description: Run the registered lexical-lossless native XPath formatter, preserving comments, EQNames and whitespace with the shared text EOF policy.

entries.name: Color the XPath source as HTML
entries.description: Produce escaped semantic HTML source presentation through the native XPath colorizer without evaluating the expression or granting resource access.

entries.name: Filter available products
entries.description: Use namespace-qualified paths, native numeric comparison and a simple map to report products with stock at least four.

entries.name: Inspect selected native product nodes
entries.description: Export genuine retained product nodes with stable native identities, original input URI, original opening-element ranges and source maps.

entries.name: Join products to their suppliers
entries.description: Evaluate dependent for bindings over the same original XML owner, joining supplier IDs with an explicit static namespace binding.

entries.name: Apply the saved selection parameter map
entries.description: Build a native XPath map from the XML selection attributes, then filter and join through native map lookups. These are owned data parameters, not external variable bindings.

entries.name: Inspect the native map and array result
entries.description: Export the typed native map, integer, strings and array with their real query-origin frames. Computed items do not claim arbitrary data-source character lineage.

entries.name: Repair the unclosed XPath predicate
entries.description: Close the missing predicate delimiter and revalidate the same saved source. Its independent failure copy does not affect normal query inputs.
